name: Sunken Temple: the Avatar of Hakkar mind controls only the damage dealer
contract: Vanilla 5-player dungeon bosses never sleep, charm or possess a player whose CoA specialization tanks or heals
(BossControlTargeting.h, AscensionBossControlRoles.cpp). The Avatar of Hakkar 8443 is the Sunken Temple (map 109,
expansion 0) encounter boss; its SmartAI casts Cause Insanity 12888 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_CHARM) at a random
non-top-threat hostile within 30 yd, first after 14-21 s of combat and then every 25-40 s. Vanguard 21 (Guardian)
tanks; Fleshweaver 25 (Bloodmage) and Grovekeeper 58 (Primalist) heal; Boltslinger 10 (Witch Hunter) deals
damage. The tank holds top threat with continuous melee; the others hit the Avatar briefly so they join its
threat list. With a damage dealer present, Cause Insanity takes the damage dealer and never the tank or healer.
The players are level 54 humans, matching the boss, so its spells land at their normal hit chance. They group in
Stormwind and teleport into one instance, where the boss is summoned at its own stats; player health fixtures
keep everyone alive through the window. Two casts are required (first after 14-21 s, repeat 25-40 s), so a random
pick that ignored the rule would pass only rarely; the tank and healer duo scenario is the strict check.

Cause Insanity never lands on the tank or the healer
